subject: Party composition
text: The party is formed by selecting four characters from six classes, with repeats allowed and no ability to change roles later.

evidence.quote: Your four party slots will be filled by selecting from six types of character, with repeats allowed; you must commit to your team comp as soon as you start the file and cannot change party members to a different role.

subject: Black Belt
text: The Black Belt is convenient for challenge runs because it does not require equipment scaling or a class change to function.

evidence.quote: The Black Belt is highly convenient for challenge runs because it doesn't require equipment scaling or a class change to function.

subject: Crown
text: The Crown is located in a chest surrounded by pillars on the third floor of the Marsh Cave, guarded by a group of Wizards.

evidence.quote: the Crown found on the third floor of the Marsh Cave (in a chest surrounded by pillars, you will be attacked by a group of WIZARDs when you approach);

subject: TNT
text: The TNT is found in the right-hand chest of the left locked treasure room in Coneria Castle.

evidence.quote: the TNT found in Coneria Castle after obtaining the magic key (there are two treasure rooms locked by the magic key; enter the left one and open the right-hand chest);

subject: Ruby
text: The Ruby is found in a chest on the third floor of the Earth Cave after defeating the Vampire.

evidence.quote: the Ruby found on the third floor of the Earth Cave (Vampire is standing in the way, enter the room and take the chest after defeating him [achievement 3572]);

subject: Floater
text: The Floater is located in a second-floor treasure room of the Ice Cave reached by dropping through a hole from the floor above, triggering an attack by the Eye.

evidence.quote: the Floater, found in the treasure room on the second floor of the Ice Cave (you'll have to drop through a hole on the floor above to get to the place where it's located, and when you step in front of the chest you'll be attacked by the Eye);

subject: Slab
text: The Slab is located in the right-hand chest of the three chests in the top-right room on the highest floor of the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote: the Slab, found in the highest floor of the Sea Shrine where the mermaids live (the room in the top-right corner of this floor, reached by wrapping around from the top-left corner, has three treasure chests in it; only open the right chest in this room)

subject: Tail
text: The Tail is found on the third floor of the Castle of Ordeals in the throne room chest guarded by a forced ZombieD encounter.

evidence.quote: The Tail is not required for story progression and you don't have to go for it if you're also aiming for Don't Change For Anyone [achievement 398475], but if you wish to obtain it, it's on the third floor of the Castle of Ordeals, the sole chest in the room with the throne and the forced ZombieD encounter.

subject: Class Upgrade
text: Turning in the Tail to Bahamut triggers the class change and unlocks the Class Upgrade achievement.

evidence.quote: The class change is triggered by turning in the Tail to Bahamut and earning Class Upgrade [achievement 3577].

subject: Class change
text: Skipping the class change prevents party members from learning spells that revive dead allies or allow immediate dungeon escape.

evidence.quote: The main consequence of skipping the class change is that your ability to use high-end magic will be very limited; in particular, you'll never learn a spell that revives dead allies or allows you to escape dungeons immediately.

subject: Ribbon
text: Characters can wear Ribbons without a class change, and spellcasting equipment does not need to be equipped to use its effects.

evidence.quote: Don't Change For Anyone also limits your access to high tier equipment somewhat, though spellcasting equipment does not need to be equipped to use its effects, and you can still wear Ribbons without undergoing a class change (a major pain factor in the no-chests run is not having any Ribbon wearers).

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: The main floor of the Temple of Fiends contains three chests in the left corners holding a Cap, a Cabin, and a Heal potion.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter the Temple of Fiends to the northwest of Coneria, you can find 3 chests on the left corners of the main floor, which contain a Cap, a Cabin, and a Heal potion.

subject: Princess Sara
text: Talking repeatedly to Princess Sara after defeating Garland rewards the Lute and allows crossing the northern bridge.

evidence.quote: Once you've knocked down Garland and obtained Sara's gift [achievement 3569] (don't forget to talk to her until you get the Lute!), you can now cross the bridge north of Coneria to a new landmass.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Matoya's Cave contains three chests with two Heal potions and a Pure potion.

evidence.quote: If you cross the bridge and keep heading straight north until you can't anymore, you'll bump into Matoya's Cave, which contains 3 chests with a Heal potion, another Heal potion, and a Pure potion.

subject: Peninsula of Power
text: Winning a battle on the Peninsula of Power must be done before talking to Bikke and his pirates in the top left corner of Pravoka.

evidence.quote: This must be done before talking to Bikke and his two pirate buddies in the top left corner of the town of Pravoka (earning Pirate Bay [achievement 3570]). The Peninsula of Power is an area reached by walking south of Pravoka, east through the mountain pass, turning north as soon as you can, and then continuing north past the boat dock until you reach the edge of the landmass.

subject: ZomBull
text: The two grass tiles on the Peninsula of Power spawn high-level Lefein enemies, including the ZomBull which has 224 HP and a weakness to fire.

evidence.quote: The two grass tiles at the very end of this peninsula have bugged encounter data and contain enemies from the Lefein area that you are meant to encounter much later in the game. You'll want to use a Tent or other saving item before walking on those tiles, as many of the potential encounters on the Peninsula of Power are highly dangerous. The encounter you're most likely to make it out alive from is a single ZomBull, which is blessedly not that uncommon; exploit its weakness to fire if possible and hope you get through its 224 HP before it finishes chewing through your team with its melee attacks.

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: Two chests near the entrance of the Dwarf Cave contain 450 G and 575 G.

evidence.quote: Most of the chests here are locked away until you have the magic key, but you can open two near the entrance for 450 G and 575 G.

subject: Ship
text: Holding A and pressing B 55 times while on the ship triggers a 15-block sliding puzzle minigame that awards 100 G.

evidence.quote: Holding A and then pressing B 55 (fifty-five) times while on the ship will trigger a sliding puzzle minigame to occur. There are 15 blocks with numbers on them, and your goal is to slide them until they've been sorted into order. Successfully do so, and you'll get 100 G and this achievement.

subject: Elfland graves
text: Interacting with the graves north of the inn in Elfland triggers an easter egg.

evidence.quote: The southern port you can access with the ship at this point will drop you off in the vicinity of Elfland. Go into the town and head around north of the inn to happen on some graves; interact with them to find an easter egg.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: Four chests on the northern side of the second floor of the Marsh Cave contain 680 G, a Large Knife, a Short Sword, and 620 G.

evidence.quote: The northern side of the second floor has 4 chests (680 G, Large Knife, Short Sword, 620 G); the south part of the floor has a few empty chests inside the rooms.

subject: Marsh Cave
text: The third floor of the Marsh Cave contains six chests holding Iron Armor, 295 G, a Copper Bracelet, a House, 385 G, and the Crown.

evidence.quote: The third floor has 6 non-empty chests you can open at this point, including Iron Armor, 295 G, Copper Bracelet, House, 385 G, and a **required chest** (in the room down 3 rows and right 1 column from the entrance stairs) containing the CROWN.

subject: Magic key
text: Defeating Astos with the Crown yields the Crystal, which is traded to Matoya for the Herb to awaken the Elfland prince and receive the magic key.

evidence.quote: Speaking of locked rooms, once you've taken the Crown to Astos and defeated him, you can trade off the Crystal he dropped to Matoya, who will give you the Herb, which will wake up the prince of Elfland [achievement 3571] to give you the magic key.

subject: Elfland Castle
text: A locked room in the top-right corner of Elfland Castle contains four chests holding a Silver Hammer, 400 G, 330 G, and a Copper Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Starting with the Elfland region, walking around the outside edge of the castle to the top-right corner of the map will lead you to a locked door containing 4 chests (Silver Hammer, 400 G, 330 G, Copper Gauntlet).

subject: Northwest Castle
text: A locked room in Astos' castle northwest of Elfland contains three chests holding a Power Staff, a Falchon, and an Iron Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Making your way back to Astos' castle northwest of Elfland will allow you to crack open a room with several forced encounter tiles and three more chests (Power Staff, Falchon, Iron Gauntlet).

subject: Marsh Cave
text: Three locked chests along the south edge of the third floor of the Marsh Cave contain a Silver Bracelet, a Silver Dagger, and 1020 G.

evidence.quote: After cleaning out Elfland castle and the northwest castle, the Marsh Cave isn't too far off, and we can now grab the last three chests along the south edge of the third floor (Silver Bracelet, Silver Dagger, 1020 G).

subject: Coneria Castle
text: The locked rooms in Coneria Castle contain an Iron Armor, Iron Shield, and TNT in the left room, and an Iron Staff, Sabre, and Silver Dagger in the right room.

evidence.quote: The left locked room in Coneria Castle contains three chests (from left to right: Iron Armor, Iron Shield, **TNT**-which you must obtain to progress). The right room contains another three chests (Iron Staff, Sabre, Silver Dagger).

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: Locked rooms in the top-right and bottom-right corners of the Temple of Fiends contain three chests with a Were Sword, a Soft potion, and a Rune Sword.

evidence.quote: Unlock the doors in the top right and bottom right corners of the temple for a total of 3 chests (Were Sword, Soft potion, Rune Sword).

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: The locked south chamber of the Dwarf Cave contains eight chests with a Cabin, Iron Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Dagger, Wooden Helmet, Silver Armor, 575 G, and a House.

evidence.quote: The south chamber of the Dwarf Cave is locked; opening it up reveals a bounty of 8 chests (Cabin, Iron Helmet, Dragon Sword, Silver Dagger, Wooden Helmet, Silver Armor, 575 G, House).

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: Talking to the dwarf in the Dwarf Cave with TNT opens a new sea passage to Melmond and the Earth Cave.

evidence.quote: Talking to the nearby Dwarf while in possession of TNT will result in a new sea passage being opened, meaning you can now sail to Melmond and the Earth Cave.

subject: Of Mighty Magic
text: Mastering Of Mighty Magic in one run requires starting with at least one White Mage or Black Mage, as Red Mages cannot learn any level 8 spells and will max out at 20 spells learned.

evidence.quote: If you are aiming to master the set in one run, Of Mighty Magic [achievement 27656] means that starting with at least one party member as a White Mage or Black Mage is a hard requirement; Red Mages cannot learn any level 8 spells and will max out at 20 spells learned even after their class upgrade.
